title: node.py: assert for runtime None check bypassed by -O flag
description:
Line 407 uses assert to check that persistence_revision_anchor is not None when persist_path is set. This assert can be skipped with Python's -O flag, potentially causing a None to be passed to AnnounceStatePersistence.

Location: python/src/lichen/node.py:407
Issue: assert self.persistence_revision_anchor is not None

The API contract (if persist_path is set, persistence_revision_anchor must also be set) is not enforced by explicit validation in __post_init__, only by this assert.

Fix: Replace with explicit ValueError check like:
  if self.persistence_revision_anchor is None:
      raise ValueError('persistence_revision_anchor required when persist_path is set')

Severity: P2 - potential None dereference in production with -O
